'refusal-codes.test.ts stops keeping a second copy': the EventStreamCodes class is deleted and the spread in the distinctness test now reads '...PlanEvents.declaredCodes()'. Nothing the objective names is missing and nothing beyond it is added.

The TDD line names it('the_error_codes_the_stream_declares_are_exactly_the_ones_a_client_can_see_on_the_wire') and fixes the assertion as 'expect(PlanEvents.declaredCodes()).toEqual(seen)', built with the existing EventsDouble.unable('git status refused') mother, collecting the frames and parsing the code out of each 'event: error' frame. The test in the diff is that test: same mother and same argument, same derivation of 'seen' by filtering on 'event: ${PlanEvents.ERROR_EVENT}\n' and parsing the JSON of the data line, and the same assertion over the same input against the same expected value. The cancellingWhenExhausted() cancel signal is the mother's own way of ending collected(), not a change to the assertion.
